facts.text: Sensitivity analysis changes one or several model inputs at a time to identify which inputs most affect the output and prioritize effort and physical tests.
facts.quote: Sensitivity analysis changes a model's inputs, one or several at a time, to learn which of them most affect the output, so that effort, physical tests and worry go where they matter.

facts.text: Model inputs that sensitivity analysis shows barely affect the result can be fixed at a nominal value; inputs that strongly affect the result must be measured carefully and validated physically.
facts.quote: Inputs that barely move it can be fixed at a nominal value; inputs that swing it must be measured carefully and validated physically.

facts.text: A 2018 mining dynamic stopping tool varied six inputs at five values each using 30 simulation rows and analyzed brake force, grade, initial speed, lag and rolling resistance.
facts.quote: a 2018 dynamic stopping tool that varied six inputs at five values each, 30 simulation rows, and analyzed brake force, grade, initial speed, lag and rolling resistance

facts.text: Space-filling sampling methods, including Latin hypercube and Sobol sequences, spread simulation runs through larger parameter spaces.
facts.quote: Space-filling sampling methods (Latin hypercube, Sobol sequences) spread runs through larger parameter spaces

facts.text: Sensitivity analysis determines which parameters define the corners of the validated envelope: any parameter shown to govern the safety output joins machine size, mount height and mass.
facts.quote: It decides which parameters define the corners of the validated envelope: "any other parameter that sensitivity analysis shows governs the safety output" joins machine size, mount height and mass

facts.text: When transferring validation to a new machine or sensor position, sensitivity analysis answers whether the change can affect a validated phenomenon or safety output.
facts.quote: It answers the second question in any transfer to a new machine or sensor position: can this change affect a validated phenomenon or safety output

facts.text: Sensitivity analysis of cost weights is mandatory when tuning trades nuisance braking against missed detections.
facts.quote: when nuisance braking and missed detections are traded through cost weights, sensitivity analysis on the weights is mandatory

facts.text: The cheap calibration perturbation test checks whether modest mounting changes affect perception or brake-trigger behavior; the test is a sensitivity analysis that maps calibration variables to safety metrics.
facts.quote: The cheap "calibration perturbation test" in Chapter 13, which checks whether modest mounting changes move perception or brake-trigger behavior, is a sensitivity analysis whose output is a map from calibration variables to safety metrics

facts.text: Sensitivity analysis is on every assessor's list alongside uncertainty analysis and the validity envelope because it identifies the variables that dominate the outcome and whether safety margin remains after uncertainty.
facts.quote: Sensitivity analysis is on every assessor's list, paired with uncertainty analysis and the validity envelope, because it "shows which variables dominate the outcome and whether safety margin remains after uncertainty"

facts.text: Sensitivity analysis for the collision mitigation validation program can start before the prototype arrives.
facts.quote: it can start before the prototype arrives [Chapter 10]
